gates.detail: The saved booking search lists NT Parks campgrounds. Permit-only Aboriginal land is left out. Camps with no booking coordinates are left out. Commercial caravan parks were not in the booking list.
TODO: attribution wording is a placeholder until NT Parks confirms it. attribution_confirmed is false.
NT Parks amended coordinates are applied only when the name matches a booking-system campground. Unmatched names are not applied.
Commercial caravan, holiday and tourist parks stay out. None were in the booking list.
Pages link to NT Fire and Rescue. No Bureau of Meteorology feed.
Signup and the digest stay off while the region flag is off. No NT topic or segment is created.
The Northern Territory is not in the public build. Victoria, New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia and Tasmania stay as they are.
